latest.text:
Alcaraz beat Zverev for the 8th time in 14 meetings, 6-2, 7-6 in the final. Set 2 went to a tiebreak, won by Alcaraz. Zverev saved 3 break points in the opening game. Alcaraz won 4 games in a row from 0-1 down in the first set. Alcaraz landed 59% of his first serves, compared with his 69% average on hard over the last 52 weeks and won 71% of his first-serve points (31 of 44). Alcaraz won 46% of the points against the first serve (23 of 50), compared with his usual 34%. Zverev struggled on his second serve, winning only 42% of the points (8 of 19), compared with his 56% average on hard over the last 52 weeks and made 31 unforced errors against 12 winners.
